review: Reviewed exact source/Core/Smart pair. Core gained one component, sf-flag, which ships the country flag set in two shapes -- 28x20 rectangles and 24x24 circles, the circle redrawn rather than cropped -- and the country code field now resolves its flag base to that set instead of falling through to the system emoji font. Smart runtime is unchanged apart from the rebuild. No attribute, property, event, slot, nesting rule, cleanup path or asset reference of a Smart component is touched, so none of the eight lessons changes.
